summary_text: Near-Term Catalyst: Whether Bilibili can sustain margin improvement without sacrificing growth. Q1 2026 reported: revenue RMB 7.5B (+7% YoY); advertising +30% YoY (13th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth); gross margin 37.1%; quarterly EPS $0.19 vs Zacks $0.17 (+15.15% surprise). AI integration improved ad efficiency; automated ad spending penetration 85%. Creators with 1000+ followers +30% YoY; avg creator income +24%. Upcoming catalyst: Bilibili scheduled to report (Q2 or repeat reference to Q1) on May 27, 2026 after close per TipRanks listing — note: this may be a stale calendar item since Q1 was already reported earlier in May.
